scope: Eight current Stormward threshold approach stills at supplied 1920x1080, pixels only. No before images, numeric context mapping or repair comparison.

inspection.method: All eight complete originals opened with view_image; no crops/retouching or additional corpus.

findings.subject: Route/ground continuity
findings.reason: Dirt approach has an abrupt angular green notch on its left edge before the threshold. A thin brown triangular sliver lies separately on the left turf, with gray triangular/strip pieces on the right. These sharp disconnected surface/material boundaries read as unfinished ground integration.

findings.subject: Threshold contact
findings.verdict: PARTIAL: visible slab, incomplete complete union
findings.reason: Gray striped threshold slab is identifiable above the path end, without an obvious large open unsupported gap in these views. A narrow green band/irregular transition interrupts the dirt-to-slab connection, and surrounding grass covers some perimeter. Hidden rear/underside/full-edge contact is unassessed.

findings.subject: Near trainer/route
findings.reason: Trainer body and both feet are readable on the dirt strip. No gross trainer burial or body intersection is visible. The immediate lane toward the threshold remains open despite grass along its edges.
findings.limits: Appearance only, no collision/support, movement or walking continuation proof.

findings.subject: Onward route
findings.reason: The route is readable up to the threshold, but beyond it the view opens into sky/haze and low vegetation without a clearly exposed continuation or near-drop geometry. These stills cannot establish where the route goes after the threshold.

findings.subject: Architecture/material finish
findings.reason: Brick walls and blue/yellow banners distinguish the landmark, but repeated block materials, plain rectangular banners and minimally designed luminous ring/bar/sphere shapes remain below the reference finish. Intentional prop support/function or placeholder provenance is not inferred.

findings.subject: Vegetation/terrain finish
findings.reason: Sparse oversized paper-like grass blades, dense repeated grass bands, broad uniform turf and coarse faceted background rock do not form the coherent layered upland terrain/material presentation required by the reference.

findings.subject: Light/sky readability
findings.reason: The pictures visibly vary between pink/warm/cool-blue lighting and some contain rain streaks. Landmark silhouette, immediate trainer and route are readable throughout. This does not prove temporal transitions, all-weather quality or device readability.

findings.subject: HUD presentation
findings.reason: Large story panel and separate shortcut/binding overlays cover substantial right-hand wall, banner and ground detail. Text itself is readable at the supplied resolution.

owning_requirements: Coherent reference-backed terrain/material transitions without unfinished seams, angular cuts or disconnected surface fragments.
Readable integrated architecture, near route and actors.
Cloudreach layered natural/art presentation and readable scenery without excessive billboard clutter.
limits: Debug-travel/staged-party presentation fixtures only; no earned campaign, device, motion, complete biome matrix or whole criterion proof.
Eight supplied pictures only; no before comparison, temporal/source cause, fix hypothesis or numeric context mapping.
No mechanical support, collision, walkability, onward journey, actor identity/system or weather-transition claim.
No concealed/full-perimeter/underside contact inspection. Bright ring/bar/spheres are described visually, not classified as unsupported/floating mechanics.
No catalogue rerating, other-row judgment, READY or whole F40/F08 promotion. All historical FAIL/PARK witnesses remain unchanged.
